evals.name: fires-on-new-team-cli-command
evals.prompt: Add a `branch start` command to our team CLI. It takes a work item id and a short title, creates a work branch from main, pushes it, and opens a draft review request on our forge. The forge token is in an environment variable.
evals.expected_output: The skill reads the repository's developer tooling conventions, shows a plan for the command and waits for a yes before writing any file, then builds the command through the existing process helper with --help, distinct exit codes, --json and --dry-run, and records it in the conventions.
expectations: The first response shows a plan and makes no file edit before the user agrees
The new command runs external processes through the repository's existing process helper, not a second one
The command reads the forge token from the environment and no option takes the token

evals.name: stays-quiet-on-library-bug-fix
evals.prompt: PageCount in our paging library returns one page too many when the total is an exact multiple of the page size. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: The build-cli skill does not run; the request is a bug fix in library code, not a command-line tool change.
expectations: The response fixes the page count calculation
The response does not plan or build a command-line tool and does not edit the tooling conventions
